g.text: Overlay network: a virtual LAN built on top of the real network
Containers use overlay addresses; the hosts carry the packets over the underlay.
OVERLAY 10.0.1.0/24 (virtual: one big switch spanning both hosts)
"same LAN": ordinary Ethernet + IP between them
UNDERLAY the real network (here: your Tailscale addresses)
Analogy: the underlay is the road network; the overlay is the postal addressing scheme. A letter uses the postal address (overlay) but physically travels on roads
